game_concept: A strategy race set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before goblin raiders exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before goblin raiders exploit the gap. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the knight ahead. Then check the bugs_fixed value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the royal vault by solving code steps involving bugs_fixed that move the knight forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the royal vault first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Uninitialized Hunt
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Castle Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
